beats.narration_text: My three computers finally act like one. I can work from anywhere.
beats.visual_goal: INT. SNOWY CABIN. Character with laptop; 3 distant blue towers glow in sync.

beats.narration_text: But getting here? It took six months of absolute hell.
beats.visual_goal: Holo-sync pulse across machines. Transition to glitchy flicker.

beats.narration_text: Monday morning. Everything stopped. Ten thousand lines of code, and half of it was garbage.
beats.visual_goal: INT. DARK OFFICE. Character buried in red clay wires. Strobe red light.

beats.narration_text: AI wrote a back door. I approved it. I didn't even know it was there.
beats.visual_goal: CLOSE UP - MONITOR. Screen cracks; door handle 'SHELL INJECTION' pops out.

beats.narration_text: Five agents building the same thing. Three date formatters. Four ways to validate a string.
beats.visual_goal: INT. CODE JUNGLE. 5 robots building conflicting bridges in clay forest.

beats.narration_text: It looked convincing. That's why it was dangerous. I was vibe coding with no map.
beats.visual_goal: Character pulls vine; entire forest collapses into a clay knot.

beats.narration_text: Implementation is free. But deciding what to build? That's the only thing that isn't.
beats.visual_goal: INT. CLEAN STUDIO. Character pins minimal blueprint to pristine off-white wall.

beats.narration_text: Specs don't come from conference rooms. They come from the grind.
beats.visual_goal: Character walks across sturdy clay bridge over organized grid.
